propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in tests cause CI flake under runner contention and must be detected and blocked via code-review gate.

Unescaped upper-bound assertions must be escapable via reasoned '# timing: hang-guard — <reason>' marker or '@pytest.mark.skipif(os.environ.get("CI") == "true")' guard; bare '@pytest.mark.benchmark' marker does not escape.

Two migration sites (test_config_perf.py:201 and test_enrich_drain.py:261) replace timing assertions with miss-path function spies (cfg._ordered_layers, Q.pending_enrichment) proven via regression simulation.
Detector must be wired as CI gate step with teaching message naming both escapes and counting-proxy migration path.
Remaining 11 in-scope sites carry reasoned hang-guard markers; detector self-excludes via EXCLUDED_FILES idiom to avoid tripping on its own RED fixture tests.
